Name: Full Fishing Bar
Author: Jag3dagster
Description:
[b]Full Fishing Bar[/b] is an open-source mod for [url=https://stardewvalley.net]Stardew Valley[/url] that allows players to have the fishing bobber bar take up the full range during the fishing mini game, effectively trivializing the minigame but keeping all other things the same.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/03calCX.gif[/img]

[size=4][u][b]Documentation
[/b][/u][/size][u][size=3]Overview
[/size][/u]When enabled, this mod will set the fishing mini game's "Bobber Bar" to take up the entire possible range.

You may be asking yourself, "Why in the world would I want this when there are instant catch mods available?"
Potential Answers:
[list]
[*]Accessibility without totally breaking balance
[list]
[*]Playing the fishing mini game can be very difficult for some players for reasons unintended by the original design
[*]This mod helps to maintain some amount of balance without completely blowing out the fish economy
[/list][*]Instant catch fishing takes a ridiculously small amount of time in-game
[list]
[*]This mod allows you to take the normal amount of time that fishing would take out of an in-game day
[/list][*]Very obvious in multiplayer server if you are using instant catch mods
[list]
[*]This mod helps you be a bit more covert about your fishing, allowing you to still appear to be fishing normally
[*]You are still able to cancel the fishing mini game early to give the appearance of failing the mini game
[/list][/list]
[size=3][u]Config[/u][/size]
[list]
[*]IsEnabled
[list]
[*]Whether or not the mod will function and resize the fishing mini game's bobber bar
[*][i]Default:[/i] [b]true[/b]
[/list][*]OnlyCorkBobber
[list]
[*]Whether or not the Bobber Bar resizing only works when a Cork Bobber is equipped on the current fishing rod
[*][i]Default:[/i] [b]false[/b]
[/list][*]BarSizePercentageInt
[list]
[*]What percentage of the mini game play space do you want the Bobber Bar to take up?
[*][i]Default:[/i] [b]100[/b]
[*][i]Range:[/i] [b]10[/b] - [b]100[/b]
[/list][*]ExceptBossFish
[list]
[*]Whether or not the mod will [b]skip[/b] resizing the fishing mini game's bobber bar [b]for Boss Fish[/b]
[*][i]Default:[/i] [b]false[/b]
[/list][*]AutoHook
[list]
[*]Whether or not the mod automatically hook a fish when it nibbles
[*][i]Default:[/i] [b]false[/b]
[/list][/list]

[u][size=3]Install[/size][/u][list=1]
[*]Install the latest version of [url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url][list=1][*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]Nexus Mirror[/url]
[*][url=https://github.com/Pathoschild/SMAPI/releases]GitHub Mirror[/url]
[/list]
[*][i]Optional but recommended[/i] Install the latest version of [url=https://spacechase0.com/mods/stardew-valley/generic-mod-config-menu/]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url][list=1][*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Nexus Mirror[/url]
[/list]
[*]Install this mod by unzipping the mod folder into 'Stardew Valley/Mods'
[*]Launch the game using SMAPI
[/list]
[u][size=3]Compatibility[/size][/u][list]
[*]Compatible with...
[list]
[*]Stardew Valley 1.6 or later
[*]SMAPI 4.0.0 or later
[/list][*]No known mod conflicts[list]
[*]If you find one please feel free to notify me here or on [url=https://github.com/jag3dagster/AutoShaker]GitHub[/url]﻿
[/list]
[/list]
[size=3][u]Limitations[/u][/size]
[u]Solo + Multiplayer
[/u][list]
[*]This mod is player specific, each player that wants to utilize it must have it installed
[/list]
